subject: Vendor engagement kickoff — calendar, procurement milestones, playbook
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Delgado <s.delgado@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 17:08:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor engagement kickoff — proposed agenda & times

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for taking the call last week. Per our discussion, the next step is a focused kickoff with your engineering + procurement stakeholders to align timeline, evidence needs, and next steps for a pilot deployment. I pulled together a short kickoff playbook and an initial scope matrix for you (attached).

Proposed agenda (30–45m):
- Introductions & success criteria (5m)
- High-level deployment model and timelines (10m)
- Procurement requirements & evidence checklist (SOC 2, retention, KMS) (10m)
- Technical touchpoints: SE brief + integration prerequisites (10m)
- Next steps & action owners (5m)

Availability: Tue/Wed next week 09:00–11:00 PT or Thu 13:00–15:00 PT. If none of those work I can share a 3-slot calendar poll.

Attaching: redwood_kickoff_playbook_v1.pdf (playbook) and initial_scope_matrix.xlsx (high-level scope).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: redwood_kickoff_playbook_v1.pdf (PDF, 320KB); initial_scope_matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 24KB)

From: Sofia Delgado <s.delgado@acme-retail.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Luke Morrison <luke.morrison@acme-retail.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme-retail.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor engagement kickoff — proposed agenda & times

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the playbook — looks helpful. Luke (ENG) and I reviewed the agenda and we want procurement and security on the call as well. Procurement is available next Wednesday 09:30–10:30 PT, and security can join in the second half if needed. Can Marissa (SE) be on the technical portion? Also procurement has asked for a SOC 2 report and a short statement on data residency ahead of kickoff — is that something you can share?

If Wednesday works, can you lock it in for 09:30 PT? If not, send the poll.

Best,
Sofia Delgado
Director, Platform Engineering | Acme Retail
Sofia.Delgado@acme-retail.com

Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor engagement kickoff — proposed agenda & times

Sofia —

Wednesday 09:30 PT works; locking in now. Marissa will own the technical walkthrough portion and I looped Aditya for procurement questions/contract touchpoints.

Quick notes on the SOC 2/data residency ask:
- SOC 2 Type II report: I attached a sanitized extract with the auditor statement and scope; we can provide the full report under an NDA or via your security portal.
- Data residency: our hosted offering stores data in the US by default; we have dedicated-region options for EU/APAC customers and a Private deployment option for on-prem/VPC. I included a short statement in the attachment.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-acme-kickoff (invites sent to everyone cc'd).

If procurement needs additional paperwork before the call, please flag what specific docs (vendor questionnaire, W-9, standard DPA) and we'll prioritize.

Thanks — see you Wednesday.

Best,
Karthik

Attachment: redwood_soc2_excerpt.pdf (PDF, 180KB)

From: Luke Morrison <luke.morrison@acme-retail.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sofia Delgado <s.delgado@acme-retail.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme-retail.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor engagement kickoff — procurement checklist

Hey team —

A couple items procurement asked us to confirm prior to kickoff so we can route internally: 
- Estimated pilot duration and milestones (we typically break pilot into data ingest -> integration -> validation -> go/no-go)
- Billing model for pilot (do we need an MSA or can we do a PO for evaluation credits)
- Point of contact for security for follow-up Qs (email and phone)

I can drop the pilot milestone template into our shared folder if that helps. Otherwise all set for Wed 09:30 PT.

Luke
Senior Staff Engineer | Acme Retail

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Luke Morrison <luke.morrison@acme-retail.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sofia Delgado <s.delgado@acme-retail.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme-retail.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor engagement kickoff — technical prep

Thanks, Luke —

I'll prepare a 10–12 minute SE brief that covers integration touchpoints (auth, network egress, KV cache considerations), expected infra for a pilot (2–4 GPU instances typical), and a short ops checklist for rolling to Dedicated or Private. I'll also include a slide with the contact for our security lead (email + phone).

I'll upload the deck and a short integration readiness checklist to the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-kickoff-resources

See you on Wednesday.

—Marissa
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachment: se_kickoff_deck_draft.pptx (PPTX, 1.2MB)

Karthik/Sofia —

Confirmed: procurement will join the kickoff at 09:30 PT today. A couple of housekeeping items we expect to cover in the kickoff and immediately after the call:
- W-9 + vendor setup forms (please send PDF forms)
- Standard PO process and expected lead times for issuing initial PO (we use Coupa)
- NDA/DPA status — procurement will request the template for review after the call

Karthik — please route the W-9 and any vendor setup forms to procurement@acme-retail.com. If you need any signatures today, include instructions in the email body.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Procurement Team
